name: salesforce
description: Access Salesforce CRM data via the Salesforce-hosted MCP gateway. Opportunities, accounts, contacts, and SOQL queries.

connection.instructions:
Salesforce requires a Connected App. In Salesforce Setup → App Manager → New Connected App:

1. Enable OAuth Settings
2. Set the Callback URL to the value shown above
3. Add scopes: api, refresh_token, offline_access
4. Save and copy the Consumer Key and Consumer Secret below.

fields.name: OAUTH_CLIENT_ID
fields.label: Consumer Key (Client ID)
fields.helpText: From your Salesforce Connected App settings.

fields.name: OAUTH_CLIENT_SECRET
fields.label: Consumer Secret (Client Secret)
fields.helpText: From your Salesforce Connected App settings. Stored encrypted.
